tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sde brgyad la springs pa'i yi ge bzhugs so//

/oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdag nyid bcom ldan he ru kas// lha srin thams cad zil gyis gnon// khams gsum dngangs zhing 'dar bar byed// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /rigs ldan lha yi gdung 'dzin 'di// 'jig rten gsum na 'gran bral ba// skyabs kyi mchog gyur chos kyi rgyal// gzhan don gshegs pa'i gser gdung dag /lha mi'i bsod nams gsog pa'i rten// gnas mchog gangs dkar ti se'i mgul// gad pa gser gyi bya skyibs su// 'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa la// lha mi sus kyang skad cig tsam// gnod dang 'tshe bar ma byed cig |mthun rkyen yar ngo'i zla bzhin du// 'phel zhing rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// gal te gnod 'gyur byas pa na// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs dang*// he ru ka yi mthu rtsal gyis// lus sems thal bar rlog par byed// de bas dam las ma 'da' bar// ci bsam chos ldan grogs su gyis// zhes 'brug lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco brgyad la rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs nas bris pa dge// 'di mnga' ris rgyal sras par/ rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po'i gser gdung bzheng bar chas te/ gdug pa can lam 'phrang bgegs rnams la bka' 'dogs dgos zhes par| 'bri gung pa dkon mchog phun tshogs kyis rang lo bcu'i thog tu bris/// / ༈ /long po drung 'tsho ba rdo rje don grub la gnang ba/ lhan gcig skyes pa he ru kaḥ shrī ma hā kā lā'i lung*/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob 'bri gung pa chen po'i gsung*/ nga rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gtam/ srog bdag 'jig rten gyi 'gong po/ klu dang sa bdag /ma mo dang btsan/ gza' dang rgyal po/ dmu dang bdud la sogs pa thams cad la springs pa/ gso dpyad kyi mkhan po rdo rje don grub ces pa 'di/ gar 'gro gar sdod kyang gang gi sgo nas dge ba'i las ji ltar bgyid na'ang*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan pa rgyas pa dang*/

sman dpyad kyi sgo nas tshogs gnyis spel sbyang bgyid pa la/ 'dzin skyong la rlung gi phan grogs byed pa gal che zhing*/ gal srid yi ge mthong bzhin 'gal ba dang tshe srog la brku na/ he ru ka chen po khros pa'i pho nya rnams dang*/ bden stobs drag sngags kyi sgo nas/ gnod byed gang yin pa de'i lus sems rdul phran bzhin du rlog pas nges par gyis/ sdong zhing phan grogs bgyid pa'i mthu rtsal ldan pa rnams yang dag phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la sbyor ba'i dam tshig dang bcas lcags khyi zla ba lnga pa'i nyer bdun la bkra shis tshugs nas bris// // ༈ /mkhar rtse'i lcam dkon mchog la gnang ba/ rgyal ba shākya'i dbang pos mchog tu lung bstan pa/ nā gardzu na'i ngo bo ratna shrī'i gdung gi tha chung lha mchog ma hā ri ṣi'i rnal 'byor pa shākya'i btsun pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gtam/ khyod gnod byed klu gong pa bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa la springs pa/ dpon sa dkon mchog ces pa 'di'i srog lus dbang rlung dang bcas pa drang srong dri med kyis bsrungs zin pas gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor skad cig tsam yang ma byed/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas phan grogs su gnas par gyis/ yi ge 'di la 'gal na bdag nyid drang srong khros pa'i khro bo zhe sdang rdo rje'i dmod pas/ khyod kyi lus sems thal bar rlog cing rnam shes kyang rdo rje dmyal bar bskal pa'i bar du sdug bsngal gyi char 'beb pas nges par gyis/ dam tshig las ma 'gal na yid dang mthun par phan tshun byams pas mi 'dor bar ngas shes/ chu pho byi ba lo hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gsum la sgar chen nas bris// //maṅga laṃ//
